notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with at least 9 power.
description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping them, adding at least {4}{W}{R}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping them, untapping Selvala
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Samut from the battlefield to your hand and giving Kogla indestructible until end of turn.
Cast Samut by paying {3}{R}{G}.
Repeat.
If you control a creature with at least 10 power, this combo produces infinite colored mana.
